preserved_failures.reason: Exact PR-head commit was absent from normal clone; complete pinned history bundle supplied in a fresh build retry
Selected 1.29.1 installation omitted DatabaseRole CRD needed by native main 1.30.0-rc1; exact source-bundled installation corrected in fresh snapshots
Empty actions list caused postprocessing IndexError after successful application execution; original raw exception retained, separate copied-artifact postprocess uses TDD fix

Assumed only two CA Creates in entire affected run. First affected run additionally retried server CA after release. Final supplemental audit preserves strict target hold/duplicate/error proof and separately substantiates each post-release retry.
Older complete manifests omit cached byte total; new helper derives bytes from the same exactly matching file/size/hash maps.

limitations: This reproduces a documented upstream bug; it is not a new discovery.
One fixed fault trial bounds the conclusion to this exact source pair, default shared-CA setup and event schedule.
Affected cache NotFound is inferred from the unchanged native ensureCASecret path plus duplicate Create and real AlreadyExists, not fabricated informer state or directly logged Get contents.

First affected trial has an additional server-CA AlreadyExists retry after API-cache release. This is retained separately and does not establish that the client-CA fix eliminates every possible server-CA cache race.
The one-second workload sampler saw the later server-CA phase in affected trial 1; the full API timeline and native error identify the preceding target client-CA error.
No permanently stuck cluster is demonstrated: schedule release is outcome driven and all cases recovered.
SQL writes/reads are after database readiness and before the final 30-second stability observation; this is not a continuous-query outage test for an existing application.
The raw no-fault postprocessing exception and generic unsupported physical verdicts remain unchanged.
